kernel: Amsterdam standard-mainnet PUSH0 and PUSH1-PUSH32 dispatch and operational semantics

push2Fusion.eligibility: untraced PUSH2 with at least two immediate bytes followed by JUMP or JUMPI
push2Fusion.stackLimitPrecheck: stack overflow is checked after PUSH2 gas and before terminal/fusion selection
push2Fusion.terminalRule: remaining immediate bytes <= 2 advances PC by 2 without a push after the overflow check
push2Fusion.jumpRule: charge JUMP, validate the big-endian immediate destination, skip JUMPDEST, charge JUMPDEST
push2Fusion.jumpiRule: charge JUMPI, pop condition, zero falls through past PUSH2 immediate and JUMPI; nonzero follows JUMP
push2Fusion.destinationRule: JumpDestination accepts only a valid JUMPDEST and returns its code offset
